description: Mi Unlock (Mi Flash Unlock): Xiaomi's official tool to unlock the bootloader of Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones. English build.
notes: Mi Unlock only finishes what Xiaomi has allowed: on HyperOS, first apply in the Xiaomi Community app
(Me > Unlock bootloader), then bind the account on the phone (Developer options > Mi Unlock status,
over mobile data). Until both are done the tool refuses or shows a waiting time.
Unlocking erases all data on the phone.
This is the English build (miflash_unlock_en_*.zip). Do not swap in the Chinese one
(miflash_unlock_<version>.zip without '_en'): its config/app_info points to the China region.
The bundled fastboot.exe and Xiaomi USB driver installer stay in the app folder, off the PATH.
That Xiaomi driver lists only Xiaomi and Google USB IDs: phones on MediaTek (VID_0E8D, e.g. PID_201C in
fastboot) stay 'Android' with a yellow mark in Device Manager and Mi Unlock does not see them. Install the
suggested Google-USB-Driver and bind 'Android Bootloader Interface' to that device by hand (see its notes).
config.ini and history.ini are copied to the persist folder on update and uninstall.
Decline the tool's own update offer: update with 'scoop update Mi-Unlock'.
pre_install: # Mi Unlock writes config.ini and history.ini next to its exe. They are copied in here and back out in
# pre_uninstall (which also runs on update) instead of persisted: a hardlink would break if a file is replaced.
